[Thinking]
**Calculating Dice Probability**

I'm currently analyzing the constraints of the problem: rolling two standard dice. My focus is on determining the possible outcomes and identifying any that result in a sum of 13.
[/Thinking]

The probability of getting a 13 when throwing two standard dice is **0** (or 0%). 

Here is why: A standard die has numbers from 1 to 6. Even if you roll the highest possible number on both dice (a 6 and a 6), the maximum sum you can get is 12. Since it is impossible to roll a 13, the probability is zero.
